title: Leader Finding: A New Variation of Expert Finding in Community Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.26921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expert finding ranks people by their knowledge of a given topic. Many job positions need more than topical expertise, and a team leader is a clear case. A suitable leader knows the technical areas of the project without being overqualified, has strong managerial knowledge, and communicates well with the team. We study the leader finding problem, where the query is a project and a team and the output is a ranked list of candidate leaders. We model the problem in a probabilistic framework that combines technical fit, managerial knowledge, and communication with the team, and we propose one evaluation metric for each of these qualities. On two large collections built from Stack Overflow, the best configuration of our model more than doubles the NDCG@10 of the strongest baseline. These results show that a ranking of leaders must balance several qualities that topical expertise alone does not capture.

translated_title: 领导者发现：社区问答中专家发现的新变体
translated_abstract: 专家发现是根据人们对给定主题的知识对人员进行排名。许多职位需要的不仅仅是主题专业知识，团队领导者就是一个明显的例子。一位合适的领导者了解项目的技术领域且不至于资历过剩，拥有扎实的管理知识，并能与团队良好沟通。我们研究了领导者发现问题，其查询是项目和团队，输出是候选领导者的排名列表。我们在一个概率框架中对这一问题进行建模，该框架结合了技术匹配度、管理知识和与团队的沟通能力，并针对这三种素质分别提出了一项评估指标。在从Stack Overflow构建的两个大型数据集上，我们模型的最佳配置将最强基线的NDCG@10提高了一倍以上。这些结果表明，领导者的排名必须平衡多种素质，而仅凭主题专业知识无法捕捉这些素质。
tldr: 该论文提出“领导者发现”这一新问题，通过概率框架综合技术匹配度、管理知识和团队沟通三项指标对候选领导者排序，在Stack Overflow数据集上的NDCG@10较最强基线提升了一倍以上。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the leader finding problem, modeling candidate leaders in a probabilistic framework that balances technical fit, managerial knowledge, and team communication, more than doubling NDCG@10 over the strongest baseline on Stack Overflow datasets.
